text.text: Nexus 7000 Series 4-Slot System is smallest form factor chassis in the Nexus 7000 family making it ideal for small/medium data center core/aggregation and data center edge deployments. Some of the highlights of 7004 include : High-Availability with redundant supervisors and In Service Software Upgrades (ISSU). Scalability with modular NX-OS features such as FabricPath and FEX. Transport Flexibility with support for 1GE, 10GE, 40GE and 100GE interfaces and extensive Data Center Interconnect features including OTV, LISP and MPLS. Operational Efficiency with Virtual Device Context (VDC) for efficient resource utilization and single software image with consistent NX-OS features across the Nexus 7000 series switches.

text.text: Cisco Nexus 7004 is 7 RU (7 Rack Units) in height. It has 2 dedicated supervisor slots for full redundancy and 2 I/O module slots. It supports Sup2, Sup2E, all F2, F2e, M2 and M1-XL modules. It has 4 power supply slots that can take either 3 KW AC or 3 KW DC power supplies. All modules including Fan tray and power supplies are accessible from the front.

text.text: Nexus 7000 Supervisor2E module scales the control plane, management and data plane services for Cisco Nexus 7000 systems. Supervisor2E is designed with Dual Quad-Core processor and 32G of memory and provides highest scale and performance. Some of the highlights of Sup2E include : Support for 8 Virtual Device Contexts (VDCs) Admin VDC VDC CPU shares FCoE support

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 7000 F3-Series Module integrates the broadest set of data center focused switching technologies, including industry standards as well as Cisco’s own innovations: Performance : non-blocking 12 ports 40GE with 720 million packets per second of forwarding capacity Layer2 and Layer3 comprehensive feature set makes this module excellent for data center networks, in which density, performance, and continuous system operation are critical FabricPath support: with Cisco FabricPath organizations can build resilient, flexible, and if needed, massively scalable Layer 2 networks Nexus 2000 support: The Cisco Nexus 2000 Series Fabric Extenders (FEX) are designed to simplify data center architecture and operations by dramatically reducing the points of management VxLAN support: wire rate hardware support for VxLAN which solves the layer2 connectivity problem of multi-tenancy environments Data Center Interconnect (DCI) : OTV and VPLS makes the module ideal in helping customers simplify the extension of applications across geographically dispersed data centers LISP support: Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP) provides enterprises and service providers with the ability to simplify multi-homed routing, and facilitates scalable any-to-any WAN connectivity while supporting data center virtual machine mobility MPLS : High Performance MPLS - 40GE for data center deployments

The Cisco Nexus 7000 F3-Series Module integrates the broadest set of data center focused switching technologies, including industry standards as well as Cisco’s own innovations:
Performance: non-blocking 12 ports 40GE with 720 million packets per second of forwarding capacity
Layer2 and Layer3 comprehensive feature set makes this module excellent for data center networks, in which density, performance, and continuous system operation are critical
FabricPath support: with Cisco FabricPath organizations can build resilient, flexible, and if needed, massively scalable Layer 2 networks
Nexus 2000 support: The Cisco Nexus 2000 Series Fabric Extenders (FEX) are designed to simplify data center architecture and operations by dramatically reducing the points of management
VxLAN support: wire rate hardware support for VxLAN which solves the layer2 connectivity problem of multi-tenancy environments
Data Center Interconnect (DCI): OTV and VPLS makes the module ideal in helping customers simplify the extension of applications across geographically dispersed data centers
LISP support: Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP) provides enterprises and service providers with the ability to simplify multi-homed routing, and facilitates scalable any-to-any WAN connectivity while supporting data center virtual machine mobility
MPLS: High Performance MPLS - 40GE for data center deployments

text.text: The Cisco Nexus® 7000 Series AC power supply modules deliver fault tolerance, high efficiency, load sharing, and hot-swappable features to the Cisco Nexus 7000 Series Switches. The 3.0-kilowatt (kW) AC power supply module for the Cisco Nexus 7000 Series is a single 20-ampere (A) AC input power supply. Connecting to high line nominal voltage (220 VAC) will produce a power output of 3000W. Connecting to low line nominal voltage (110 VAC) will produce a power output of 1400W.
